note: Five small redistributable CC0 effects selected from the repository's pinned sound library. prepare.mjs verifies each original SHA-256, decodes offline to mono PCM16 WAV, trims silence, adds sub-millisecond attack and 4ms tail ramps, and limits each source peak to -3dBFS. catalog.json records source and derived hashes and exact frame counts. No paid service, upload or network request is involved. pulse-108.wav is the existing original Pure Kinetic pulse arrangement rendered without scene effects by prepare-pulse.py. music.json pins its source script, output bytes and measured levels. This original music bed is separate from the five CC0 effects.
